details: US spot Ethereum ETFs recorded approximately $4.95 million in net outflows on June 12, with BlackRock's ETHA and Fidelity's FETH leading the withdrawals. This marks a continuation of outflows, contributing to Ethereum's price remaining below key moving averages. Analysts note that geopolitical risks and a hawkish stance from the Federal Reserve are additional factors exerting downward pressure on ETH.
title: Ethereum Spot ETFs Face Continued Outflows, Price Under Pressure

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has approved an active cryptocurrency exchange-traded fund (ETF) that will include Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and XRP as eligible assets. This regulatory milestone is seen as a significant step towards broader institutional acceptance and participation across these major cryptocurrencies.
title: SEC Greenlights Active Crypto ETF Featuring BTC, ETH, and XRP

details: Following its recent $1.8 trillion initial public offering (IPO), Elon Musk's SpaceX has reportedly disclosed significant Bitcoin holdings, positioning the aerospace company among the largest public holders of the cryptocurrency. This development, highlighted by Michael Saylor, suggests increasing institutional confidence and the growing adoption of Bitcoin by prominent corporations.
title: SpaceX IPO Confirms Major Bitcoin Holdings, Signals Institutional Trust
